name: tool-card
description: One MCP tool as a card: what kind it is (thin or outcome), its name, what it does, the form Claude fills in, the API it calls, and how that call went (ok, failed, or not yet).

kicker.description: small label above the name, e.g. `thin tool`

description.description: what it does, in plain words

inputs.description: the filled-in form, one `field: value` per entry

api.description: the API it calls, e.g. `CRM API`

kind.description: outcome tools get a heavier frame

note.description: a short status note, e.g. `timed out`

example.name: get_revenue
example.description: Revenue for one account, month by month.
